snippet.title: Marble Odyssey: Sandbox - Gameplay Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Marble Odyssey: Sandbox is a calm and curiosity-driven physics sandbox set on a wooden table drifting through space.
Build your own small contraptions, release the marbles, and watch their gentle flow unfold.

This trailer offers a quick look at the paths, ramps, holes, slides, mechanical blocks, and many other pieces you can create with.
Every block snaps perfectly onto a clean grid, every color theme sets a new atmosphere, and every marble behaves with detailed, realistic physics.

Marble Odyssey: Sandbox is a relaxing, creative experience focused entirely on the player.
Create your own flow—whether it’s peaceful loops, chaotic experiments, or massive marble factories.

Key Features:

• 50+ building blocks including paths, ramps, holes, slides, and mechanical pieces
• 5 mechanical blocks: timed generator, elevator, pusher, speed booster, splitter
• 90 unique marble variants
• 6 color-themed tables
• Clean, grid-based building system
• Realistic physics with detailed sound design
• A goal-free, pressure-free, relaxing sandbox experience
